research_limitations: Thresholds are predeclared hypotheses, not fitted or proven improvements on future coins.
Net reputation starts empty; no synthetic, incident-recovered, or older two-second labels are imported.
While cost-aligned history is insufficient, the existing Golden discovery rule is retained with explicit warmup flags; quote safety still applies.
Outcome comparisons are at the identical fee/delay configuration and a comparable logarithmic size bucket, not identical absolute stake.
Exact buyer cohorts are co-appearance groups, not proof of coordinated/common ownership.
The label observer may trade a signal that v2 rejects; missed observer outcomes remain unknown.
Costs, rent refund, reserve overlays and 250ms inclusion are modeling assumptions, not actual Axiom fills.
Offline crash tests cover process interruption and a local journal, not distributed high availability or on-chain reconciliation.
The future live collector, independently verified creation provenance, account refresh/migration route, and multi-day validation require a separate authorized phase.
